avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce UGT1A1 and reduce zidovudine concentrations, potentially decreasing antiretroviral efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on alternative mood support options and inform prescriber if currently used

avoid_supplements.name: Ribavirin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Antagonistic antiretroviral activity and increased risk of hematologic toxicity; may reduce zidovudine phosphorylation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination unless specifically indicated; monitor CBC closely if concurrent use unavoidable

caution_supplements.name: Acetaminophen (chronic high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Both undergo glucuronidation; potential for increased zidovudine or acetaminophen concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Use lowest effective acetaminophen dose; monitor for increased adverse effects; consider alternative analgesics

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin B12 supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Zidovudine may impair B12 absorption; supplementation provides protective benefit
caution_supplements.action: Monitor B12 levels; supplementation generally recommended with long-term zidovudine use

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (with immediate-release formulation)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Delays and reduces peak zidovudine absorption, potentially compromising viral suppression
avoid_foods.action: Administer zidovudine on empty stomach or with light meal; separate from high-fat foods by 2+ hours

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: Minor CYP3A4 inhibition; zidovudine has limited hepatic metabolism, so clinical significance is low
caution_foods.action: No strict avoidance required, but moderate consumption recommended; monitor for increased GI side effects

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (chronic/heavy use)
caution_foods.mechanism: May exacerbate hepatic metabolism and increase risk of hematologic toxicity; potential for additive mitochondrial effects
caution_foods.action: Counsel on limiting alcohol intake; monitor CBC and liver function tests with regular use

monitoring_notes: Monitor complete blood count (CBC) regularly for anemia and neutropenia, as zidovudine is known for hematologic toxicity. Assess adherence and viral load at each visit, as food/supplement interactions may compromise efficacy; counsel on consistent dosing with regard to meals.
